scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/control-plane && npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/portal
scripts.dev:stripe: command -v stripe >/dev/null && stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/api/billing/webhook || echo 'stripe CLI not found - billing webhooks will not be delivered locally'
scripts.release:dev: ENV_FILES='.env.fly .env' CONTROL_PLANE_URL=http://localhost:4000 RELEASE_BRANCH=main ALLOW_DIRTY=1 bash scripts/release.sh
